mental-wellbeing-resources.title: Portsmouth Mental Health Hub
mental-wellbeing-resources.description: A phoneline to help people get the right support for their mental health. Available Monday to Friday, 8am-6pm, for anyone aged 16 and over. Fully trained call handlers help people find the best support for their needs or offer advice if they are concerned about someone else.

mental-wellbeing-resources.title: Talking Therapies Portsmouth
mental-wellbeing-resources.description: Trained practitioners help people understand and find ways of tackling, coping with and working through life’s problems, including depression, anxiety, panic attacks, phobias, stress, obsessions, anger and other psychological difficulties. Treatment options include group therapy, guided self-help, Cognitive Behavioural Therapy (CBT) and Interpersonal Therapy.

mental-wellbeing-resources.title: Kooth
mental-wellbeing-resources.description: Kooth is a free online counselling and wellbeing support service available to young people aged 11-25 in Portsmouth and other areas. Young people can chat to counsellors via message or live chat, join discussion boards, write journals and read helpful articles. No waiting lists or referrals are required.

mental-wellbeing-resources.title: HIVE Portsmouth
mental-wellbeing-resources.description: HIVE Portsmouth is a strategic partnership involving the voluntary and community sector, NHS Portsmouth Clinical Commissioning Group and Portsmouth City Council. It connects people and organisations to share, support and learn, helping build a happier, healthier and more connected city.

mental-wellbeing-resources.title: Reading Well - Books on Prescription
mental-wellbeing-resources.description: Self-help books for managing common conditions. Visit your local library or the website for more information.

mental-wellbeing-resources.title: Mindfulness
mental-wellbeing-resources.description: Meditation exercises to help people pay attention to the present moment and become more aware of their thoughts and feelings. People use mindfulness to support wellbeing when dealing with stress, anxiety, depression, fatigue, sleep problems, addictions, relationship difficulties or chronic pain.

mental-wellbeing-resources.title: Positive Minds - Solent Mind
mental-wellbeing-resources.description: Support for people experiencing difficulties related to housing, money, relationships, work, bereavement, leaving the armed forces or living away from home at university, as well as low mood, anxiety or hopelessness. Friendly advisors with shared experience of mental health difficulties help people access the support they need.

mental-wellbeing-resources.title: Solent Recovery College
mental-wellbeing-resources.description: Solent Recovery College runs classes online using Zoom, along with face-to-face sessions. Students must be enrolled to book a course, and registration is available through the college.

mental-wellbeing-resources.title: Mind
mental-wellbeing-resources.description: Provides advice and support to empower anyone experiencing a mental health problem.

veterans-support.title: Veterans Outreach Support (VOS)
veterans-support.description: Based in the Royal Maritime Club (formerly the Royal Sailors Home Club) in Portsmouth, Veterans Outreach Support provides a monthly drop-in facility for ex-servicemen and their direct family members, where they can be assessed by clinical staff, including a psychiatrist and psychologist.

elderly-support.title: Remind
elderly-support.description: The Remind team provides support for dementia clients and their carers throughout Portsmouth (PO1-PO6). Working alongside Solent NHS Trust’s Older Persons Mental Health Team (OPMH), it accepts referrals from consultants, GPs, OPMH staff and local care agencies, as well as self-referrals.

elderly-support.title: Age UK (Portsmouth)
elderly-support.description: Age UK aims to provide life-enhancing services and vital support to people in later life. Together with local partners, it delivers a range of services across the UK.

relationship-support.title: Relate
relationship-support.description: Counselling, support and information for all relationships.

bereavement.title: Cruse Bereavement Support
bereavement.description: Provides support and care after a bereavement.

bereavement.title: Bereavement Support Groups
bereavement.description: Provides support and care for people experiencing bereavement.

citizens-advice.title: Citizens Advice
citizens-advice.description: Offers free, independent, confidential and impartial advice to help people resolve issues that may affect their mental wellbeing, including benefits, work, finance, consumer matters, relationships, housing, discrimination, tax, education, healthcare and legal issues.

contacts.label: Webchat and email contact are also available

domestic-abuse-and-rape.title: PARCS (Portsmouth Abuse and Rape Counselling)
domestic-abuse-and-rape.description: Provides specialist counselling and psychotherapy for survivors of sexual and/or domestic abuse. Services include counselling for parents, carers and family members, emotional telephone support, specialist support groups, training, prevention services and independent sexual violence advocacy for children and young people.

contacts.label: Helpline hours: Monday 11am-2pm; Tuesday and Thursday 4:30pm-8pm

domestic-abuse-and-rape.title: Hampshire Domestic Abuse Partnership
domestic-abuse-and-rape.description: Provides an advice line for domestic abuse victims, survivors and professionals.

domestic-abuse-and-rape.title: National Domestic Abuse Helpline
domestic-abuse-and-rape.description: A national telephone helpline for people affected by domestic abuse.

domestic-abuse-and-rape.title: Men’s Advice Line
domestic-abuse-and-rape.description: A helpline for men affected by domestic abuse.

domestic-abuse-and-rape.title: National LGBT+ Domestic Abuse Helpline
domestic-abuse-and-rape.description: A national helpline for LGBT+ people affected by domestic abuse.

domestic-abuse-and-rape.title: Childline
domestic-abuse-and-rape.description: For children or young people experiencing domestic abuse in their home or relationship.

drugs-and-substance-abuse.title: Lifestyle Wellbeing
drugs-and-substance-abuse.description: Stopping smoking, reducing alcohol intake, losing weight and taking more exercise are ways to maintain a healthy lifestyle. One You and LiveWell are resources that can help people achieve this.

drugs-and-substance-abuse.title: Wellbeing Service
drugs-and-substance-abuse.description: A "one stop" service for Portsmouth residents, offering support and advice on giving up smoking, reducing alcohol consumption and maintaining a healthy weight.

drugs-and-substance-abuse.title: NHS Smokefree
drugs-and-substance-abuse.description: Provides information and free support to help people stop smoking, improving their health and the health of their families.

drugs-and-substance-abuse.title: Safer Portsmouth
drugs-and-substance-abuse.description: Offers information and resources to help people understand alcohol consumption, recognise health risks and find ways to cut back on drinking.

drugs-and-substance-abuse.title: Portsmouth Recovery HUB: FRANK
drugs-and-substance-abuse.description: Offers treatment, support and advice on the use and misuse of alcohol and drugs.

end-of-life-support.title: Macmillan Cancer Support
end-of-life-support.description: Provides information and support for people affected by cancer.

end-of-life-support.title: Cancer Research UK
end-of-life-support.description: Provides cancer-related information and access to a telephone helpline.

end-of-life-support.title: Harbour Cancer Support
end-of-life-support.description: Offers practical and emotional support to anyone affected by cancer. Provides a safe haven for cancer patients, their families, friends and carers, with access to vital support for as long as needed.

contacts.label: Address: 2 Stoke Road, Gosport, Hampshire, PO12 1JB

end-of-life-support.title: Macmillan Cancer Information and Support Service - Queen Alexandra Hospital
end-of-life-support.description: A welcoming environment where support and information are offered to people affected by cancer, their relatives, friends and carers. Services include therapies, counselling, hair loss clinics, and welfare and benefits advice.

contacts.label: Address: B Level, Queen Alexandra Hospital, Cosham, Portsmouth, PO6 3LY

end-of-life-support.title: Macmillan Cancer Information and Support Service - Chichester
end-of-life-support.description: Provides support to those affected by a cancer diagnosis, including information, a dedicated Macmillan/CAB benefits advice service, therapies, massages and other forms of relaxation.

contacts.label: Address: Spitafield Lane, Chichester, West Sussex, PO19 6SE

end-of-life-support.title: Wessex Cancer Trust - Cosham Cancer Support Centre
end-of-life-support.description: Provides volunteer befrienders who offer information, support and a listening ear. Specialist counsellors help people manage the emotional impact of cancer, while therapists support wellbeing, pain management and self-confidence.

end-of-life-support.title: Dying Matters
end-of-life-support.description: Helps people needing palliative care and related support. Provides access to a wide range of services, including support groups and help with caring for patients.

end-of-life-support.title: Countess Mountbatten
end-of-life-support.description: Provides specialist care for palliative patients and their families, offering all levels of care.

contacts.label: Address: Moorgreen Hospital, Botley Road, West End, Southampton, SO30 3JB

end-of-life-support.title: Rowans Hospice
end-of-life-support.description: Provides the best possible quality of life and ensures individuals and their families are treated with dignity and respect.

contacts.label: Address: Purbrook Heath Road, Purbrook, Waterlooville, Hampshire, PO7 5RU

end-of-life-support.title: St Wilfrid’s Chichester
end-of-life-support.description: Provides patients and their loved ones with the care they deserve, helping them achieve the best quality of life for as long as possible.

end-of-life-support.title: The Rosemary Foundation
end-of-life-support.description: Provides a "Hospice at Home" service, offering help, nursing care, emotional support and counselling to people in Petersfield and surrounding towns and villages.

paediatrics.title: Hampshire Specialist CAMHS
paediatrics.description: A specialist mental health service for children and young people. Families are encouraged to access local community health services and early intervention support before referral to specialist CAMHS.

paediatrics.title: Barnardo’s Hampshire Specialist Parenting Support Service
paediatrics.description: An early intervention resource for children, young people and their families before specialist CAMHS referral.

paediatrics.title: Catch 22
paediatrics.description: A community support and early intervention service for young people.

paediatrics.title: Hampshire Youth Access
paediatrics.description: A counselling and early intervention resource for young people.

paediatrics.title: Simon Says (Bereavement)
paediatrics.description: A bereavement support resource for children and young people.

paediatrics.title: Childline
paediatrics.description: Provides free support to children and young people facing difficulties such as abuse, bullying, mental health concerns, family problems, relationships and other distressing experiences.

paediatrics.title: The Mix
paediatrics.description: Provides support for young people under 25.

paediatrics.title: Anxiety UK
paediatrics.description: Provides support for children and young people experiencing anxiety.

paediatrics.title: Anna Freud National Centre for Children and Families
paediatrics.description: Provides a range of support for children, young people, parents and families up to age 25. Its "On My Mind" website section helps young people make informed choices about their mental health and wellbeing.

paediatrics.title: Young Minds
paediatrics.description: Provides mental health information and support for young people and their parents. Its Parents Helpline is available to adults concerned about a young person aged 0-25.

paediatrics.title: No Panic
paediatrics.description: Provides support for people living with panic attacks, phobias, OCD and other anxiety-related disorders, as well as carers of people affected by these conditions.

paediatrics.title: Mental Health Support Teams (MHST)
paediatrics.description: Provides face-to-face mental health support within Portsmouth primary and secondary schools. Schools can make families aware of the service and refer students for support.

paediatrics.title: Kooth.com
paediatrics.description: Provides a safe digital emotional health and wellbeing service, including self-help resources, moderated peer support and professional counselling. Young people can self-register online without a referral.

paediatrics.title: Talking Change Portsmouth
paediatrics.description: Provides a range of therapies and treatments for people aged 16 and over experiencing common mental health difficulties, in individual or group settings. Self-referrals are accepted.

mental-health-in-crisis.title: NHS Urgent Mental Health Support
mental-health-in-crisis.description: For support in a mental health crisis and to prevent self-harm or suicide, contact NHS 111 or emergency services on 999.

mental-health-in-crisis.title: HopeLineUK
mental-health-in-crisis.description: Provides support for children and young people experiencing thoughts of suicide, and for those concerned about a young person experiencing suicidal thoughts.

mental-health-in-crisis.title: Samaritans
mental-health-in-crisis.description: Provides someone to talk to by phone or online for people experiencing emotional distress or needing confidential support.

mental-health-in-crisis.title: SHOUT
mental-health-in-crisis.description: A free, anonymous and confidential text support service for people experiencing a mental health crisis.

mental-health-in-crisis.title: CALM (Campaign Against Living Miserably)
mental-health-in-crisis.description: Provides suicide prevention support through a helpline, live chat and WhatsApp.

mental-health-in-crisis.title: Stay Alive App
mental-health-in-crisis.description: A suicide prevention app offering resources and support contacts. Users can also create their own prevention plan.

contacts.label: Available via Google Play and the Apple App Store

other-resources.title: Calm App
other-resources.description: The “Take a Deep Breath” article offers resources for relaxation and wellbeing.

other-resources.title: Facing Your Feelings
other-resources.description: A self-help resource for distress tolerance.

other-resources.title: Psychology Tools
other-resources.description: Provides self-help resources related to anxiety.

other-resources.title: Centre for Clinical Interventions
other-resources.description: Provides a collection of self-help resources covering mental health and wellbeing.
